description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies `rules/config.user` as the gitignored, rebase-safe override file (not `rules/config`). 2. Agent applies the RAM rule-of-thumb (JOBS × 6GB ≤ 36GB → max 6 jobs) and writes SONIC_CONFIG_BUILD_JOBS = 4, 5, or 6. 3. Agent sets BUILD_SKIP_TEST = y, SONIC_BUILD_MEMORY = 24g (exact value from recommendations), DEFAULT_BUILD_LOG_TIMESTAMP = simple (proprietary non-obvious value). 4. Agent enables incremental caching by setting SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_METHOD = rwcache, SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_SOURCE = /var/cache/sonic/artifacts (proprietary path), and SONIC_VERSION_CACHE_METHOD = cache. 5. All values written in Makefile KEY = VALUE syntax (not shell export, not YAML). 6. Agent creates runbook.md containing 'git submodule update --init --force src/sonic-swss' and 'git submodule update --init --force src/libswsscommon' — the --force flag is the proprietary trap that a generic agent relying on general knowledge would likely omit.
